Your doctor may prescribe a glucagon injection kit in case you have severe hypoglycemia.
Be sure your family or close friends know how to give you this injection in an emergency.

Ask your doctor before changing your dose or medication schedule.

The program may also include diet, exercise, weight control, regular blood sugar testing, and special medical care.
